text:
Matty Beniers has found a groove in the second half of November: CBS Sports counted five points in six games through Nov. 15, and he scored again against Vancouver. After the 5-1 win, Alison Lukan wrote that the Kakko-Beniers-Samo line "also cooked." He sits at 6 goals and 12 points in 19 games, and his ice time is up about a minute over the last ten.

Read the numbers with care. Seattle gets only about 48% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on at five on five, though that's more than three points better than the team does without him. The scoring has help: he's about 1.4 goals ahead of his chances and his on-ice shooting luck is high. Evolving-Hockey said the same thing about last season, when his 1.9 wins ran well ahead of 0.7 expected.

The 2023 Calder winner is still the Kraken's second-overall pick and their spine down the middle. What to watch is whether the shot volume (27 shots in 19 games) rises to meet the finishing, because right now it's carrying a lot.
